freeTier.note: The free 'Experiment' tier applies to a subset of models with monthly token allowances measured on a rolling basis. Which models are included and the allowance size change; no figures are asserted here.

notes: Model catalogue read from /models. Free-tier eligibility per model is not exposed by the API, so it is stored as operator-configurable metadata (Settings → Models) and defaults to UNKNOWN rather than assuming free access.
